name: Healthcare

typical_workflows.name: Medical coding and billing
typical_workflows.description: Assign billing codes and prepare insurance claims.

typical_workflows.name: Patient enquiries
typical_workflows.description: Answer questions about opening hours, preparation and results process.

typical_workflows.name: Referral and records handling
typical_workflows.description: Read referral letters and file them in the right record.

compliance_notes: Health information is highly sensitive and tightly regulated (for example HIPAA in the US, GDPR special-category data in the EU). Confirm legal requirements with your compliance lead before sending any patient data to an AI service.
Prefer providers that sign a data processing or business associate agreement, and do not use patient data for model training.
AI must not make clinical decisions on its own; keep a qualified person in the loop for anything affecting care.
Consider removing names and identifiers before processing where possible.
follow_up_questions: Does this task involve patient names, diagnoses or other health records?
Which country or region are you in (this decides which privacy laws apply)?
Does a clinician review the result before it is used?
Which record or practice management system holds the data, and can it export or connect?
